purpose: Route condition/course questions to records without inferring diagnosis or timing.

routes.reader_need: why is this dying different from another death?
routes.interstitial: Different illnesses can decline in different shapes; this route is orientation, not prediction.
Cancer records are not a timeline and cannot assess a person’s symptoms.
Dementia can involve long uncertainty; clinical and care-team context matters.
Organ-failure trajectories can include crises and partial recoveries; this is not triage.

routes.reader_need: voice, swallowing, or communication changing in ALS/MND/Parkinson’s
routes.interstitial: Communication and swallowing questions require professional support; the record preserves language and witness context.

routes.reader_need: sudden severe stroke and palliative care
routes.interstitial: Stroke is emergency/clinical territory; these records explain words families hear, not decisions.

routes.reader_need: very old, frail, not bouncing back
routes.interstitial: Frailty is not just age; the archive must not turn it into a reason to dismiss treatable distress.
